query: INSERT INTO password_totp_enrollments(team_id,item_id,key_id,state,cleanup_after,agent_user_id,wake_id) SELECT $1,$2,$3,'pending',now()+interval '180 seconds',$4,$5 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_activity WHERE team_id=$1 AND item_id=$2 AND id=$3 AND NOT (action='agent_totp_setup' AND user_id=$4)) ON CONFLICT(team_id,key_id) DO UPDATE SET key_id=password_totp_enrollments.key_id WHERE password_totp_enrollments.item_id=excluded.item_id AND password_totp_enrollments.state='pending' AND password_totp_enrollments.agent_user_id=excluded.agent_user_id
